map.适用于死后早期（数小时内）、环境温度约18-20°C的粗略估算。0.83为经验冷: Applicable to the early post-mortem period (within a few hours) as a rough estimate at an ambient temperature of about 18 to 20°C. Here 0.83 is the empirical cooling rate (°C/h).

map.按 Glaister 简易公式 时数=(37-直肠温)/0.83，Henssge: By the simple Glaister formula, hours = (37 - rectal temperature)/0.83; by the Henssge correction, hours = (37.2 - rectal temperature)/(K × correction), with K ≈ 0.4 × sqrt(70/weight) and correction = clothing × environment. A weighted combination of the two is used, cross-checked against the corneal clouding grade (0 to 4).
map.直肠温 Tr=32℃、环境温度 Ta=20℃、体重 70 kg、衣着/环境系数均: With rectal temperature 32°C, ambient 20°C, weight 70 kg and clothing/environment factors of 1: Glaister = (37-32)/0.83 = 6.0 h and Henssge = (37.2-32)/(0.4×1) = 13.0 h (95% interval about 10.2 to 15.8 h), giving a weighted combined estimate of about 10.6 h, that is more than 10 hours after death.
map.尸温法在低温/水中尸体准吗？: Is the body cooling method reliable in low temperatures or in water?
map.不准。低温、浸泡、发热疾病、衣着厚重会显著改变冷却曲线，Henssge 法已做校: Not really. Low temperatures, immersion, febrile disease and heavy clothing all change the cooling curve significantly. The Henssge method applies corrections but remains approximate, so it should be combined with livor mortis, rigor mortis, stomach contents and other findings.
map.单指标误差大（尸温受环境波动、角膜受个体差异），多指标（尸温+尸斑+尸僵+胃内容: A single indicator carries large error (body temperature fluctuates with the environment, the cornea varies between individuals). Convergence of multiple indicators (body cooling, lividity, rigor, stomach contents and entomology) is what raises the reliability of the inference.
